name: projectId
label: Project ID
help: From Submit a video link, a Watch events module (Autopilot episode imported, or an Operation finished event) or Make an API call.

name: forceRegenerate
label: Generate again
help: Yes generates new clips even if the project already has some. Narriflow remembers a request for good, so repeating identical settings is a permanent replay of the first run. To run again, change a setting or map a new Run key.

name: clipCountTarget
label: Number of clips
help: How many clips to look for, from 3 to 30. Leave empty for 10.

name: specificMoments
label: Specific moments
help: Describe moments to find, in up to 500 characters. For example: every time the guest mentions pricing.

name: finishing
label: Finish automatically
help: When clips are ready, Narriflow exports the best ones and writes their copy, then the Finishing finished event fires. Leave empty to skip. Needs a plan with campaign operations.

spec.name: topClips
spec.label: Top clips
spec.help: Export this many of the best clips, from 1 to 10. Required to finish automatically.

spec.name: minScore
spec.label: Minimum virality score
spec.help: Skip clips that score below this, from 0 to 100.

spec.name: copyPlatforms
spec.label: Write copy for
spec.help: Also write a caption for each exported clip on these platforms.

name: runKey
label: Run key
help: Narriflow remembers a request for good, so the same inputs are the same request forever. Map the trigger's Event ID here to run once for each event, or change any input to run again.
